name: execute_operation
title: Execute one command as the Operator or PM
description: Start ONE command on the shared operation path, as you, on your own authority (merge and other owner commands need an owner request); follow it with get_operation until final. A K3 effect waits for the owner, then runs by itself: do not repeat it. Kinds, fields: get_guide with topic "operations".

request_key.description: Names this call within the open request: the same key is the same operation and never runs twice; repeat it only to retry the same call (with another command: super_request_conflict).

task_key.description: The card the command is about, when there is one.

command.description: The command: kind plus its fields; the fields of each kind are in get_guide with topic "operations".

annotations.title: Execute one command as the Operator or PM
